context: This week's 12 teams put up 1740.7 points between them, 145.06 a team.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: ROK Navy's Finest left 73.8 points on the bench this week -- including 26.6 from Jaxson Dart, who never even got on the field.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: Chig-a-Doodle-Doo's defense (well, their opponent's offense) did the work: Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 finished with just 94.86.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: Not close: Chig-a-Doodle-Doo beat Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 by 64.14 points, 159.0 to 94.86.
